Name: GitGuardian
Author: Microsoft - support@microsoft.com
Description:
The [GitGuardian](https://www.gitguardian.com/) solution for Microsoft Sentinel ingests GitGuardian workspace audit logs and secret incidents through the Codeless Connector Framework (CCF). It provides visibility into administrative activity and exposed-secret remediation, including incident lifecycle, severity, validity, risk, assignment, detector, tags, exposure, ticket, and occurrence details.

**Underlying Microsoft Technologies used:**

This solution takes a dependency on technologies that might be in [Preview](https://azure.microsoft.com/support/legal/preview-supplemental-terms/) or result in additional ingestion or operational costs:

a. [Codeless Connector Framework (CCF)](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/sentinel/create-codeless-connector)

b. [Log Ingestion API](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/azure-monitor/logs/logs-ingestion-api-overview)

c. [Data Collection Rules (DCR)](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/azure-monitor/essentials/data-collection-rule-overview)
